name: Takada Nobuchina
source:
The daughter of a Yakuza family. Her words can sometimes be harsh, but that's because she cares for her friends. With her vast array of skills, she's been running the house while her father is away. She also never stops fighting with her sister.

“Friends don't leave friends behind. They never abandon each other.”
